_description: Extension schema for r/covidlonghaulers. Activates 2 base-optional fields and adds 4 COVID-specific extension fields.

infection_count.description: How many times the patient has been infected with COVID

long_covid_duration_months.description: How long the patient has had Long COVID specifically (in months)

functional_status_tier.description: Functional capacity level (housebound, bedbound, mild, moderate, severe). PEM/crash are symptoms captured under 'conditions', not functional status.

biomarker_results.description: Lab values, biomarkers, or test results mentioned
